author: The keeper
pages: Fog all day. Lamp lit at the fourth bell. Two cogs passed south, one longship north, close in. Fished from the jetty: three cod and a betty.

Storm. Lamp out twice; relit it. A ship's horn in the night, very near. In the morning, barrels on the shingle and no ship.

The gulls have taken to sitting on the gallery rail. I have taken to talking to them.
